meta.titre: {annee} property price barometer: rises, falls and the most expensive towns
meta.description: Rankings based on actual sales (DVF database): biggest rises and falls in price per m², the most expensive and most affordable towns in France. Continuously updated.

jsonLd.description: Property price rankings by town (rises, falls, most expensive towns) calculated from actual sales in the DVF database (DGFiP), rolling 12 months.

intro: The rankings below are calculated from sales actually recorded by the French State (DVF database) over the last 12 months of published data, not from listings. Updated on {date, date, long}.
indisponible: The rankings are being updated and will be back shortly. In the meantime you can <lien>value your property</lien>.
seuil: Rankings limited to towns with at least {seuil} sales over 12 months, to remain statistically meaningful. Paris, Marseille and Lyon appear by arrondissement.

cta.titre: And your property, how much is it worth?
cta.texte: Free valuation in 2 minutes, based on actual sales in your neighbourhood.

methodologie.texte: Median prices per m² calculated by town and property type from transactions in the "Demandes de valeurs foncières" database (DVF, DGFiP): private sales only, one dwelling per transaction, outlier bounds (surface 8-500 m², price €200-25,000/m²). Change: median of the last 12 months of published data compared with the previous 12 months. {dvf}. {anil}.
methodologie.presse: Journalists, bloggers: this data may be freely reused with the credit "source: {marque} barometer" and a link to this page. Contact: {email}.
